findings.summary: Budget-utilization uniqueness migration can fail on existing duplicate rows
findings.details: V9 adds unique indexes over budget_utilizations without first detecting or consolidating historical duplicates. The branch itself adds ensureExists(... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) because concurrent first award calls could race before this change; any tenant that already hit that race will make Flyway fail when CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runs, blocking rollout before the app starts.
findings.recommendation: Add a pre-index migration step that identifies duplicate global/location budget_utilization keys, merges utilized amounts deterministically, deletes duplicates, and fails with a clear diagnostic if automatic merge is unsafe; then create the unique indexes.

findings.summary: Catalog update can violate CASH returnability invariant and surface as a database error
findings.details: Create validates CASH + isReturnable, but update applies category and isReturnable independently and then saves. Changing a returnable NON_CASH item to CASH, or setting isReturnable=true on an existing CASH item, reaches the chk_cash_not_returnable database constraint instead of being rejected as a business rule. That turns a predictable admin validation error into a late persistence failure and likely a 500 response.
findings.recommendation: After applying the requested fields, validate the final item state before save: reject CASH items with isReturnable=true, and either clear return-window fields or validate them consistently for non-returnable items.

classificationRules.blockingThreshold: severity critical/high AND confidence >= 0.70 AND not alreadyHandled
classificationRules.advisoryThreshold: severity medium/low OR confidence < 0.70 OR alreadyHandled
